levels.surface: عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك الأنصاري

notes: «وقال غيره» is a second isnad for the same saying with an unnamed first transmitter.
The first isnad stops at جعفر بن ربيعة as written; the names from عبد الرحمن بن هرمز on are written in the second isnad only, so they are read there.
Ka'b is the last link: the Prophet's words («يا كعب») are the saying's frame, reported by Ka'b.
